trial_court: Principal Judge Family Court at Chikmagalur, M.C.No. 224/2022
case_name: Smt Souharda Rudrappa vs Sri Vinay Raj H D

parties.respondent_defendant: Sri Vinay Raj H D, husband

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2017. They lived together until December 2022 when the petitioner received a divorce notice and relocated to Bangalore. The respondent instituted a divorce petition under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
cited_cases: N.C.V.AISHWARYA v/s A.S. SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA, (2022) SCC online SC 1199

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the inconvenience that would be caused to the wife along with their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto.
legal_principles.held: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the inconvenience that would be caused to the wife along with their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto.
cited_cases: N.C.V.AISHWARYA v/s A.S. SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA, (2022) SCC online SC 1199
keywords: prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto

outcome.final_order: The court transferred the divorce proceedings from Chikmagalur to Bangalore.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 CPC
